verdict.rationale: Cursor's core interaction model is natural-language driven: docs describe scoping changes via Plan Mode, handing off tasks to agents in plain language, launching parallel agent fleets, and always-on agents triggered by natural instructions, all controlled through chat/agent prompts rather than manual commands. This directly matches the ai-native/agenticness story of operating via natural-language commands. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification specifically of natural-language command fidelity/accuracy (community evidence covers unrelated complaints like pricing/bugs, not NL command capability itself).
